reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Washington
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Is there a law regulating access to eviction records?"
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

scenario_state(washington).
scenario_year(2021).
scenario_question(is_there_a_law_regulating_access_to_eviction_records).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(washington),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_question(is_there_a_law_regulating_access_to_eviction_records).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute translation: RCW 59.18.367 (2021)
   Unlawful detainer action-Limited dissemination authorized, when.
   ----------------------------- */

/* Citation metadata */
statute_citation(rcw_59_18_367, washington, 2021).

/* We treat "eviction records" as including "unlawful detainer action" court records. */
eviction_record_type(unlawful_detainer_action).

/*
  RCW 59.18.367(1): A court may order an unlawful detainer action to be of limited dissemination
  for one or more persons if any of the listed conditions is met.
*/
rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_ground(without_basis_in_fact_or_law).  % (1)(a)
rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_ground(tenancy_reinstated).           % (1)(b)
rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_ground(other_good_cause).             % (1)(c)

/*
  Deterministic check: whether the court is authorized to enter a limited dissemination order
  given a particular ground.
*/
rcw_59_18_367_court_may_order_limited_dissemination(Ground, yes) :-
    rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_ground(Ground),
    !.
rcw_59_18_367_court_may_order_limited_dissemination(_Ground, no) :-
    !.

/*
  RCW 59.18.367(2): An order to limit dissemination must be in writing.
*/
rcw_59_18_367_order_valid(WritingStatus, yes) :-
    WritingStatus == in_writing,
    !.
rcw_59_18_367_order_valid(_WritingStatus, no) :-
    !.

/*
  RCW 59.18.367(3): When an order for limited dissemination has been entered with respect
  to a person, a tenant screening service provider must not:
   (a) disclose the existence of the unlawful detainer action in a tenant screening report, OR
   (b) use the unlawful detainer action as a factor in determining any score/recommendation.

  We encode these as prohibited actions when a valid limited-dissemination order exists.
*/

rcw_59_18_367_prohibited_action(disclose_existence_in_report).  % (3)(a)
rcw_59_18_367_prohibited_action(use_as_scoring_factor).         % (3)(b)

/* A limited dissemination order exists if the court may order it on a ground AND it is in writing. */
rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_order_exists(Ground, WritingStatus, yes) :-
    rcw_59_18_367_court_may_order_limited_dissemination(Ground, yes),
    rcw_59_18_367_order_valid(WritingStatus, yes),
    !.
rcw_59_18_367_limited_dissemination_order_exists(_Ground, _WritingStatus, no) :-
    !.

/* If an order exists, then the tenant screening service provider is prohibited from each action. */
rcw_59_18_367_tenant_screening_provider_must_not(Action, OrderExists, yes) :-
    OrderExists == yes,
    rcw_59_18_367_prohibited_action(Action),
    !.
rcw_59_18_367_tenant_screening_provider_must_not(_Action, _OrderExists, no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Higher-level legal conclusion used to answer the question
   ----------------------------- */

/*
  This statute regulates access/dissemination of eviction-record information by:
   - authorizing limited dissemination orders for unlawful detainer actions, and
   - prohibiting tenant screening service providers from disclosing/using those records
     when such an order exists.
  Therefore it is a law that regulates access to eviction records (at least in this context).
*/
regulates_access_to_eviction_records(State, Year, yes) :-
    statute_citation(rcw_59_18_367, State, Year),
    eviction_record_type(unlawful_detainer_action),
    !.
regulates_access_to_eviction_records(_State, _Year, no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Answer
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    regulates_access_to_eviction_records(State, Year, yes),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint (required)
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is there a law regulating access to eviction records?
